name: Property Finder: weekly new listings under a price to Google Sheets

nodes.name: Apify: Property Finder listings
nodes.notes: Calls the Apify API (run-sync-get-dataset-items). Needs a Header Auth credential: Name = Authorization, Value = Bearer <YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>. Change maxTotalChargeUsd to cap spend per run.

nodes.name: Append to Google Sheets
nodes.notes: Create a sheet with a header row matching these columns: runDate, listedAt, title, price, currency, propertyType, bedrooms, bathrooms, sizeSqft, community, building, furnishing, completionStatus, brokerName, listingId, url

parameters.content: Setup: Header Auth credential for Apify (Authorization = Bearer <Apify token>); Google Sheets credential + Sheet ID with a header row (see node notes). Edit city/locations/bedrooms/maxPrice (AED for country ae). Each run is charged for every listing scraped (up to maxListingsPerSearch); the filter keeps only listings first listed in the last 7 days. Optional: add a dedupe on listingId in Sheets.
